name: Hollow Coast
summary: Storm-lashed western shore of fishing, salvage, salt, contraband, mourning, sea fear, and harbor lordship.

name: Iron Principalities
summary: Mountains, mines, foundries, fortresses, dynastic workshops, and severe practical rulers known as the Iron Thrones.

name: Maritime League of Thessara
summary: Confederated world of city-states, island harbors, law courts, trade, rhetoric, and old sea devotions.

name: Northern Marches
summary: Patchwork of holds, forts, clan lands, and hard local authority; hospitality, memory, burial, and winter matter deeply.

name: Sun Dominion
summary: Bureaucratic, disciplined, orderly, imperial heir culture ruled through record, administration, roads, and formal hierarchy.

name: Valedorn
summary: Feudal, pious, lawful, status-conscious heartland ruled from Aurelis; the default campaign center.
source_documents: A Primer on the Lands of Aethrys
